operation.summary: Take a photo now. Works while the phone is locked; if the owner turned on captures.locked_camera_approval, a locked photo first waits up to 30 s for their Allow (approval_declined otherwise)

body.name: viewfinder
body.description: Optional visible capture/review; native card, portal and MCP-App captures always require it

body.name: group_photo
body.description: Offer a spoken GO shutter using approved on-device microphone access

body.name: instructions
body.description: Short framing instructions above the live preview, up to 240 characters

body.name: countdown_seconds
body.description: 0–10 seconds after the visible shutter is tapped

body.name: return_image
body.description: false returns capture metadata only; requires store:[memory] or another enabled retention destination; default true

body.name: zoom
body.description: Zoom ratio, e.g. 0.5 (ultra-wide), 1, 2, 5 (telephoto); the range is in /v1/capabilities after the first photo

body.name: max_width_px
body.description: Width limit, 64-20000, or null for full size (default 2048 unless size is given)

body.name: store
body.description: Keep this capture too: any of memory (fetch it later from GET /v1/captures/{id}), files (a copy in the phone's Downloads/Bridgit), upload (POSTed to your upload_url). [] or "none" = only return it. Default: your POST /v1/captures/storage choice, else only returned

body.name: size
body.description: Preset: agent (1568 px, q85), thumb (512, q75), large (2560, q90), original

body.name: max_edge_px
body.description: Long edge limit, 64-20000; overrides the preset

body.name: raw
body.description: 1 = return the image bytes, details in X-Bridgit-* headers

operation.returns: captured_at, width_px, height_px, format, size_bytes, data_base64 (or JPEG bytes with raw=1); capture {capture_id, stored, url, memory_until, file} when kept (X-Bridgit-Capture-Id with raw=1)
